faq.description: Discover why hundreds of clinics trust Eyadeh to simplify and manage their daily operations.

items.question: Do I need technical experience to use it?
items.answer: Not at all. Eyadeh was built to be simple, intuitive, and staff-friendly. Our team fully installs the system, provides a free training session, and remains available for ongoing support whenever needed.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Most clinics are ready in under one hour. We install the system, connect your printers, and import your patient and financial data, all handled remotely or on-site by our technical team.

items.question: What are the pricing and payment options?
items.answer: You can start with a Free Trial fully set up by our team. After that, Eyadeh offers flexible subscription plans, with no hidden fees or setup costs.

items.question: Is my data safe and private?
items.answer: Absolutely. Your clinic data is stored on secure encrypted servers with daily backups and restricted access control. Only authorized staff can access your information, and you remain the sole owner of all your clinic data.

items.question: Can I use Eyadeh on multiple devices?
items.answer: Yes! Eyadeh is cloud-based and works on any device - desktop, tablet, or mobile. Your team can access the system from anywhere with an internet connection.

items.question: What happens if I need help or support?
items.answer: Our dedicated support team is available via phone, email, and chat. We typically respond within 24 hours and provide comprehensive training materials and video tutorials.
